title: Planning lookups
subtitle: The official values that fill every planning list.

governance.heading: Official reference data
governance.body: These values fill every planning list — visit types, reasons, priorities. Every change records who made it and what it was before and after.

readOnly.heading: View only
readOnly.body: You can view these but not change them. A security administrator can give your role permission to edit them, under Users and roles.

error.heading: Couldn't load lookups
error.body: The lookup list is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed. Reload to try again.

kinds.assignment_override_reason: Reason for changing an assignment by hand

editor.rawJsonHint: Optional. A value here replaces all extra details for this row.

table.emptyBody: Add the first value for this lookup kind.

deleteNote: We never delete a value. Old records still point to it. Turn it off instead. New lists then show only the values that are on.
